morphology.formula: ∅ + Pushkin → Pushkin（俄语姓氏，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 不按马来语词缀拆分。所列 IPA 为俄语姓氏的读音，不代表已核定的马来语标准读音；正文应大写为 Pushkin。is_root 在此仅表示不作马来语派生分析。

senses.zh_definition: 普希金：俄语姓氏；文学语境中通常指俄罗斯诗人、小说家及剧作家亚历山大·谢尔盖耶维奇·普希金（1799—1837）。
senses.en_definition: A Russian surname, usually referring in literary contexts to Aleksandr Sergeyevich Pushkin (1799–1837), the Russian poet, novelist, and playwright.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Rusia yang, dalam konteks kesusasteraan, lazimnya merujuk kepada Aleksandr Sergeyevich Pushkin (1799–1837), penyair, novelis dan penulis drama Rusia.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词，pos 依给定枚举归入 noun。输入没有 DBP 独立词条定义；此处马来语释义为编写释义，不能标为官方词典原文，因此 status 保留为 unverified。姓氏也可指其他人物；无上下文时不能断定就是诗人。搭配为自然的人名组合。[Metropolitan Opera：Pushkin 生平](https://www.metopera.org/discover/education/educator-guides/eugene-onegin/the-life-and-work-of-alexander-pushkin/)

etymology.historical_story: Pushkin is the Latin-script rendering of the Russian surname Пушкин. Its familiar literary association comes from Aleksandr Pushkin, whose works include the verse novel Eugene Onegin. The [Metropolitan Opera biography](https://www.metopera.org/discover/education/educator-guides/eugene-onegin/the-life-and-work-of-alexander-pushkin/) connects that work with its later operatic adaptation. For Malay learners, the name should be remembered whole; its spelling provides no basis for identifying Malay prefixes or suffixes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Pushkin → 普希金 → 俄罗斯诗人：直接把姓名、人物与作品相连，不拆成英语 push，也不当作马来语派生词。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 一般文学讨论可直接称 Pushkin；正式介绍首次出现时宜写全名 Aleksandr Sergeyevich Pushkin，后文再用姓氏。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于文学、翻译及文化讨论。正文须保留专名大写；不能因检索键是小写 pushkin 就在正式文章中沿用小写，也不应把人名当作普通马来语词解释。
